attempts.summary: On node1 (Ubuntu 24.04), built a local apt package repository from a downloaded .deb, served it over HTTP on NODE_IP, made the real Ubuntu mirrors unreachable (removed sources, /etc/hosts blackhole), and installed the cowsay package purely from the local repo, verifying via apt-cache policy that the package came from the local source. Restored original apt sources/hosts afterward and confirmed remote reachability and package persistence. Completed the mandatory node-restart protocol: captured boot_id baseline, rebooted node1, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified cowsay and apt configuration survived the restart.
